tasks.title: Create and Switch to Model
tasks.instructions: Ensure the model `mod8-bundle-lab` exists and is the active target.
hints: Run `juju switch mod8-bundle-lab` or `juju add-model mod8-bundle-lab`.

tasks.title: Create Declarative Bundle Manifest
tasks.instructions: Create a bundle file named `bundle.yaml` in the current working directory declaring two applications: `web-app` (using the `ubuntu` charm, scale: 1) and `db-service` (using the `ubuntu` charm, scale: 1).
hints:
Create `bundle.yaml` with:
applications:
  web-app:
    charm: ubuntu
    scale: 1
  db-service:
    charm: ubuntu
    scale: 1
tasks.solution:
cat << 'EOF' > bundle.yaml
applications:
  web-app:
    charm: ubuntu
    scale: 1
  db-service:
    charm: ubuntu
    scale: 1
EOF
tasks.check: test -f bundle.yaml && grep -q 'web-app:' bundle.yaml && grep -q 'db-service:' bundle.yaml

tasks.title: Deploy the Bundle Manifest
tasks.instructions: Deploy the declarative bundle into the `mod8-bundle-lab` model using `juju deploy ./bundle.yaml`.
tasks.check: juju status -m mod8-bundle-lab --format yaml | grep -q 'web-app:' && juju status -m mod8-bundle-lab --format yaml | grep -q 'db-service:'

tasks.title: Export Live Model Topology
tasks.instructions: Export the running model topology into a bundle YAML file named `exported-bundle.yaml`.
hints: Run `juju export-bundle --filename exported-bundle.yaml` or `juju export-bundle > exported-bundle.yaml`.
